text:
natalie-pm: Hi team — Acme Security Questionnaire follow-up: they want an evidence bundle including KMS key rotation policy, access logs for service account svc-redwood-prod (last 90 days), RBAC mapping from SSO attributes to service roles, and proof of SIEM ingestion. They asked for a security review call w/ engineering next week (they suggested 2026-02-27). Can we assemble? /cc @maria-s @aj-infra

aj-infra: We can produce the logs and RBAC mapping. For the svc account we need to add a delegated role (role/redwood.infer) and confirm which SAML attribute they map (eppn vs groups). I’ll draft the infra change. Also note export path for logs: ```aws s3 cp s3://redwood-audit/backups/2026-02-*/ --recursive```

kevin-eng: Pasting a runtime trace example (sanitized) that shows KMS usage while serving in dedicated pool: ```2026-02-18T14:03:12Z INFO KMS_WRAP key_id=projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/ring1/cryptoKeys/keyA action=Encrypt principal=svc-redwood-prod request_id=xyz123``` This is what the SIEM should correlate.

maria-s: We can provide the KMS rotation policy doc and an envelope-encryption flow diagram. For HSM attestations we can include the partner assertion letter but will need to redact serials/hostnames. Regarding retention: legal flagged 7 years for certain regulated customers; our default audit retention is 3 years — need CS/product signoff to extend retention for Acme.

kevin-eng: SIEM ingest notes — we ship audit events to Splunk via collector. Example Splunk query to find KMS events: ```index=redwood sourcetype=kms action=Encrypt OR action=Decrypt principal=svc-redwood-prod | stats count by key_id``` That will be part of the evidence (screenshot + exported search results).

incbot: [incident-2358] created by aj-infra: vuln-triage requested for CVE-2026-0007 in llm-runtime dependency.

snyk-bot: SNYK: CVE-2026-0007 affecting llm-runtime@1.3.2 — upgrade available in 1.3.3. Severity: Medium. Assigned to @kevin-eng.

kevin-eng: Acknowledged. I’ll patch and run a canary on Dedicated. Plan: PR by EOD 2026-02-21, canary run, then rollout. Will attach PR link here when ready.

maria-s: For the evidence bundle we should: 1) create time-limited key access (1h) for the export job, 2) include RBAC role mapping doc, 3) include redacted HSM assertion, 4) include SIEM query + CSV of results. We also need a JIRA change ticket for the RBAC update and timebox for approvals.

aj-infra: I’ll open INFRA-4821 to track the rotation/export work and link it to the SQ. Assigning eng-oncall for execution and adding checklist (key access, export, verify checksums).

natalie-pm: Thanks — I’ll schedule the security review call for 2026-02-27 15:00 UTC and share the calendar invite with Acme. Please upload docs to s3://redwood-evidence/acme-corp/2026-02-27/ as they’re ready. :thumbsup:

maria-s: I’ll prepare rotation_policy.pdf and HSM_letter_redacted.pdf and drop into the folder.

kevin-eng: I’ll attach sanitized log samples (last 90d), the Splunk query screenshot, and the PR link for the patch once canary passes.

aj-infra: Done — created INFRA-4821 and added acceptance criteria. Linking to the security questionnaire: https://jira.redwoodprod/browse/SQ-1792

natalie-pm: One blocker: Acme needs confirmation of which SAML attribute maps to the service roles. I’ll ask them to confirm before the call. If they confirm, we should be on track.

maria-s: Noted. I’ll also prepare a short one-page incident response summary template in case they ask about detection + forensics steps.

kevin-eng: Will run the canary once INFRA-4821 creates the time-limited key. Planning window: 2026-02-21 09:00 UTC.

natalie-pm: Perfect — thanks everyone, I’ll follow up after the call is scheduled and once Acme confirms SAML attribute.
